name: Interacti Forms Connector For monday
author: interactidigital

sections.description:
This helper plugin acts as a secure connector bridge between your WordPress site and monday.com. It allows you to dynamically fetch your form lists and schemas inside monday.com for field mapping, and routes incoming submissions securely into your workspace boards.

Important SaaS & Privacy Disclosures

This plugin is a companion integration that relies on an external service to process and map form data to monday.com.

  • External Service Name: WordPress Forms Integration (monday.com app)
  • Terms of Service: https://www.interactidigital.com/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.interactidigital.com/privacy-policy

What Data is Transmitted?

No data is sent externally until you connect your site inside the monday.com app, and submissions are only forwarded once your first automation links the site. The following data is transmitted to our secure region-specific middleware endpoints (*.monday.app):
* Connection Phase: Your site name and URL, the plugin version, the form builders you have active, your list of forms (Form ID and Title), and the fields of each form (labels and types), to populate your monday.com mapping dropdowns.
* On Submission: Every submission from every form in a supported builder is forwarded, not only the forms used by an automation. Each one includes your site URL, the form ID and builder, the time of submission, a unique event ID, your integration token, and each supported field’s ID, label, type and submitted value. The app then writes it to your monday.com board if an automation uses that form, and discards it otherwise.
* Not Sent: File uploads, passwords, and card details. The plugin does not collect visitor IP addresses itself, but if a form stores one in a field, such as a hidden field, that field is sent like any other.
* Temporary Storage: If a delivery fails, the submission is kept on your site in WP-Cron and retried up to three times, then removed.

Supported Builders in this release:
* WPForms (Free & Pro)
* Gravity Forms
* Contact Form 7
* Fluent Forms
* Formidable Forms
* Ninja Forms
* Forminator Forms
* WS Form
* MetForm
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Interacti Forms Connector for monday, or click Settings on the Plugins screen. On a new install, your integration token is created on your first visit.
  3. Copy your Site URL and Token, then paste them into the WordPress Forms Integration app inside your monday.com integration setup.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without the monday.com marketplace app?

No, this is a dedicated connector designed specifically to power the WordPress Forms Integration app inside the monday.com ecosystem.

How do I stop all data transmissions?

Navigate to the plugin’s settings page in your WordPress dashboard and click “Revoke Token”. This immediately invalidates the shared secret, removes the linked endpoints, cancels any queued retries, and prevents any further data from leaving your site.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Security: Retry jobs no longer store the integration token. They read it when sending, and are dropped if the token or endpoint has been removed.
  • Revoking the token and uninstalling now clear every queued retry.
  • A mapping error can no longer interrupt a visitor’s form submission.
  • Ninja Forms: Submissions now carry the correct form ID, including forms shown more than once on a page, and 12-hour date and time values are parsed correctly.
  • Forminator: Saved drafts and abandoned forms are no longer forwarded, and numbers such as 1,234 keep their value.
  • Formidable Forms: Repeater child entries are no longer forwarded as separate submissions.
  • MetForm: Dates now follow the form’s date format, so the day and month are no longer swapped.
  • Added a Settings link and a one-time setup notice on the Plugins screen.

1.2.0

  • Added support for 6 new form builders: Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, Forminator Forms, MetForm, Ninja Forms, and WS Form.
  • Improved field handling across all integrated builders with an explicit supported types list.
  • Standardized date and time formatting to ensure full compatibility with monday.com columns.
  • Formatted consent, GDPR, and single-checkbox inputs to parse as boolean values.

1.1.0

  • Added a delivery retry mechanism using wp_schedule_single_event to improve submission reliability.
  • Implemented UI/UX enhancements on the admin settings page, including an informative instructional banner and documentation links.
  • Registered a /disconnect REST endpoint to remove webhook destinations when no active automations remain.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with support for WPForms, Gravity Forms, and Contact Form 7.
